title: Supplementary Software 1: MFP-Score, OPR, and Source-Grounded Evidence Workflow for Monolithic MOF Formation
description: MIT-licensed supplementary software and source-grounded evidence package for a manuscript on monolithic MOF prioritization. The release contains the synthetic-curated MFP-Score/OPR demonstration, a 49-record condition-level evidence registry from nine primary studies, descriptive manuscript-table generation, a nullable registry-to-model projection adapter, neutral evidence workbook, checksums and validation reports. The evidence layer is descriptive and does not generate source-grounded MFP scores, OPR rankings, classifier training, accuracy/F1/AUPRC/calibration results or synthetic imputations.
